test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A hollow spherical shell has an external diameter of 36 { cm} and an internal diameter of 28 { cm} . It is melted and recast into spherical balls, each of radius 2 { cm} . Find the total number of balls formed and the total surface area of all the balls formed.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Number of balls (n) = (External radius³ − Internal radius³) ÷ (Ball radius)³ n = (18³ − 14³) ÷ 2³ = (5832 − 2744) ÷ 8 = 3088 ÷ 8 = 386 Total Surface Area = n × 4πr² = 386 × 4π × (2)² Total Surface Area = 386 × 16π = 6176π cm² **∴ The correct answer is 386, 6176π cm².**
